name: Out of stock, large refund
description: Stark Industries orders 12 laptops; there are at most 10. The order is cancelled and, if already paid, the 36,000 refund exceeds accounting authority.
expect: INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE → OrderCancelled by Operations. If the payment was registered first: the Accounting Manager requests a REFUND decision, the CEO approves it (order cancelled and paid), and the accountant refunds 36,000.00. Stock and the invoice are restored/voided by the cancellation.
